cases.","notes":["The excerpt does not contain the stated continuing decline in trade-union strength."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E020","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E021","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["None excerpt."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E022","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E023","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The archive excerpt does not state that Sheikh Hasina received an award; it only presents the title in article metadata/headlines."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E027","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The archive reports an allegation involving bribery and teacher appointments, that the national minister."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E028","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The archive reports a UN-related item concerning Bangladesh's 12th National Parliament Election, a High attacks."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E029","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E030","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The archive reserves rose to 20.41 billion dollars."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E032","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E033","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
